title: 88% show up rate came from this one thing
description: 88% show up rate came from this one thing
transcript: Most of the time, low show up rates have to do with the content side of things, uh, than they do the actual, like all the technical aspects. In July of 2023, our show up rates had plummeted to 30%. Um, and you know, when you're spending the amount of money that we're spending on ads and you have the payroll that, that I do, it becomes pretty annoying and it's pretty costly to have a show up rate so low. So I did a analysis of 16,000 sales calls through High, Rose and Cowley. And I looked at the attributions. But by and far, like I said earlier, the vast majority of people that actually showed up the call at some point had consumed some content from me, mostly from YouTube. If I excluded out of the 16,000 sales calls, the people that actually went to YouTube, I had an 88% show up rate. So they need to be going through a few hours of content before they book a call. They need to know why they're getting on the call, they need to value the call. So you need to make sure that they're excited for that. And the only way that you can do that is by pre framing the call beforehand.
